description: The person-level primary Sustain — the smallest complete unit in the holon model. Every user has exactly one habitat: their own state, independent of any household or group Sustain (e.g. a Homestead) they may also belong to as a member.

role_in_family.description: Free-text role within a parent Sustain (e.g. 'parent', 'child') — not enforced, informational only.

finances.description: Personal finances — same shape as Homestead's, scoped to one person.

liquid.description: Unallocated liquid balance — money not yet assigned to any pocket.

pockets.description: Named personal budget pockets keyed by pocket name.

allocated.description: Total moved into this pocket from liquid

income.description: Personal income tracking — most recent recording.

operators.name: budget.record_income
operators.description: Record a personal income transaction and credit the liquid balance.

operators.name: budget.allocate
operators.description: Move an amount from liquid balance into a named personal pocket.

operators.name: budget.spend
operators.description: Record a spend against a personal pocket.

operators.name: budget.summary
operators.description: Return a budget ring ResponseWidget showing all personal pockets and key metrics.

invariants.description: A habitat's liquid balance can never go below zero. Same rule as Homestead's, scoped to one person.

enforcement._note: Same reasoning as homestead.json's opt-in: the single invariant compiles clean against state_schema and budget.allocate already self-guards to the same effect — a last-line-of-defense gate, not expected to trip in normal use.

parameters.name: owner_ids
parameters.description: List of user IDs who have owner (Level 0) access to this habitat. Required at instantiation.

parameters.name: role_in_family
parameters.description: Optional free-text role within a parent Sustain (e.g. 'parent', 'child').

parameters.name: initial_income
parameters.description: Starting income amount (KES). Defaults to 0 if not provided.

_notes.slice_status: Declared as a spec/template only (prune-and-habitat slice). Auto-provisioning a habitat on user signup is deliberately NOT wired here — that belongs to the create/definition slice (Slice 5). No live habitat instances exist yet from this change alone.
_notes.reuses_existing_operators: All four declared operators are the existing sustena/operators/budget.py implementations, already tested via homestead — no new operator code was written for habitat. homestead.tasks.* operators were deliberately left out to avoid a dot-protocol namespace mismatch (a 'homestead.*'-prefixed operator inside a non-homestead sustain) rather than papering over it.
